note: 2-3 trigger/behaviour checks per skill (skill-creator convention). Schema per skill-creator references/schemas.md: id + skill + prompt + expected_output are REQUIRED; files (input fixtures), expectations (individually gradeable statements) and expected_artifacts (paths the run must write) are optional. Each expected_output names the PRODUCT.md section + exit criteria the skill must satisfy. tools/check.py gates this structure; it does not execute the cases. Re-run on change to catch drift from VISION.md.
